ModMetadata.Name: Salty's Droid Dual Battery
ModMetadata.Author: Joshua
ModMetadata.Description: HEM Droids get a second battery slot next to the #5 battery slot. The droid drains battery 1 until it's empty, then switches to battery 2, so you can pull the empty one and swap in a fresh one without powering down. Required on both server and clients in multiplayer.
